description: This file contains the implementation of UserDao interface, providing data access methods for User entities using QueryDSL and JPA in a Spring-managed repository context.

classes.name: UserDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for UserDao, extending generic DAO for User entity and providing custom methods for user retrieval

methods.name: getByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity based on the username, joining related group, merchant store, and language entities

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity by its ID, including related entities

methods.name: listUser
methods.description: Lists all users with their associated groups, merchant store, and default language

methods.name: listUserByStore
methods.description: Lists users associated with a specific merchant store
